$comment: The Lantern Guild's sellswords (world doc §4 v1.11, GDD §6.2): what the player reads about ranks and perks. The ids are the sim's (src/sim/companions.js) and test/companions.test.mjs keeps them in step; the numbers in a line are the sim's numbers.

wick.name: Wick
wick.line: New to the Guild. Cheap, and mostly what they say they are.

lamp.name: Lamp
lamp.line: A few seasons on the road and still alive, which says something.

lantern.name: Lantern
lantern.line: Known in more than one town. Keeps one trick back until they trust you.

beacon.name: Beacon
beacon.line: A name the Vale would know. Rare, dear, and worth it.

found.name: Companion
found.line: Not the Guild's. Takes no wage.

bodyguard.name: Bodyguard
bodyguard.text: Within 3 tiles of you, takes a fifth of every blow aimed at you.

skirmisher.name: Skirmisher
skirmisher.text: +20 % damage to a foe that's fighting someone else.

finisher.name: Finisher
finisher.text: +15 % damage to a foe under half its health.

last_stand.name: Last Stand
last_stand.text: +20 % damage while under a quarter of their health.

field_medic.name: Field Medic
field_medic.text: Every 12 s in a fight, patches up the most hurt of you for 5 % of their max HP.

kindler.name: Kindler
kindler.text: Firebolt also burns those beside its target, for 0.3×.

old_campaigner.name: Old Campaigner
old_campaigner.text: Party aura: everyone regains HP 10 % faster in a fight.

deserters_bond.name: Deserter's Bond
deserters_bond.text: +10 % ATK if you left the Redhand too.

sisters_ward.name: Sister's Ward
sisters_ward.text: Their heals are 15 % stronger if you were a Grey Sisters' ward.

delvers_eyes.name: Delver's Eyes
delvers_eyes.text: +10 % ATK on a site's second floor and deeper, if you were Deepdelver-fostered.

shield_brother.name: Shield-brother
shield_brother.text: +10 % DEF while another fighter is in the party.

haggler.name: Haggler
haggler.text: The inn and the temple cost you 15 % less.

greedy.name: Greedy
greedy.text: Wants half again the wage. Foes drop 5 % more gold.

drinker.name: Drinker
drinker.text: −5 % ATK unless you've slept at an inn in the last two days.

terms.title: The Guild's terms
terms.intro: Pinned by the board in a careful hand. The Lantern Guild hires out its own: a fee to sign one on, then a wage at every dawn.

sections.head: Ranks
sections.text: Every sellsword carries a Guild rank. The higher the rank, the more they're good at and the more they cost. Fee and wage are times their level.

sections.head: Seasons
sections.text: The Guild keeps its seasoned members for companies it knows. Whoever you sign on comes at half your level, rounded up, and learns the rest at your side. Their wage grows with them.

sections.head: Wages
sections.text: Paid at every dawn, wherever you are: the two with you in full, the bench at half. Each one is paid in full or not at all, the party first.

sections.head: Owed
sections.text: A sellsword you can't pay is owed. They still fight, but their perks go dark until you settle up at a tavern, or until a dawn you can pay it all. Each unpaid dawn costs you their loyalty.

sections.head: Loyalty
sections.text: Loyalty grows a step for every dawn they're paid in your party, and for every boss you put down together. At loyalty 3 a Lantern or Beacon shows the perk they kept back. At loyalty 5 they're Sworn: a quarter off their wage, and once a room they get up from the blow that would have Downed them.

sections.head: Ask around
sections.text: New faces at the tavern, for 10 gold a level. It doubles each time you ask on the same day. A new day brings new faces anyway.

sections.head: Retrain
sections.text: A Guild drillmaster swaps one perk for another of its kind that costs no more, for 60 gold a level, more each time. A quirk is who they are: no training takes it out.

families.fight: How they fight, and who against.
families.skill: A tweak to one of their class's abilities.
families.aura: The whole party. Only the strongest of a kind counts.
families.bond: Stronger alongside the right hero or company.
families.gold: Wages, prices, and what foes drop.
families.quirk: A cost, for one more perk point.

terms.found: Companions you find, like Brannoc, aren't the Guild's. They take no fee and no wage, and come with perks of their own.
